title: 第二十三章 梦第二十四章 隐瞒
content_zh:
三斤姐气恼不已：“你呀，就是没个正经。
如果你遇到困难也能这样笑着面对，多好。”
我隔着她有一丈远：“老同，我收到我明白我懂得啦！
说真的，我也不想放弃这么好的机会，毕竟这个机会比从前任何一次都要真实都要可实际触摸。”
我话锋一转，“你就自己出来，小陈呢？”
她说：“年轻人自然是和年轻人一起玩的，她和应验在一起呢，好像是在那边。”
说完她指了指西面远远的礁石小岛。
这个礁石小岛距离海滩有几十米，其实就是一个海上平台，朝东面看去银海湾一览无遗的半圆形海滩，朝南看去是银海湾与外海的口袋位置，朝西则比较浪漫了，看着金帆顶的石山。
有海边的酒店联合起来将其布置成了一个海上音乐吧，颇受来海边的年轻人欢迎。
我顺着她手指的方向看去，只见宝蓝色海面上像浮着一朵紫色的郁金香，那是因为小岛的灯采用了大量的紫色灯在小岛的岸脚上做辅助灯的效果。
这个小岛，本来没什么，礁石而已，做成平台后，又加上了紫色灯，酒店的经营者还在网络上放了些软文推广，就像大理洱海那样的，然后又给它安上了一个听上去很俗气的名字：情人岛，但就这样俗气的名字，却吸引了很多来银海湾的年轻人前来打卡。
紫色，神秘而浪漫，没有什么人能拒绝。
我心在想：怕不是三斤姐马上也要去上岛吧？她知道这个岛的名字是情人岛吗？
正在想呢，三斤姐兴冲冲的对我说：“木木凡，我们也上岛去走走啊！
坐坐，听听音乐。”
我假装义正言辞的说：“三斤姐，我是有家室的人了。
你不要这样。”
三斤姐杏眼怒睁：“你去不去？！”
我作毫不畏惧的样子：“我说不去就不去！
我老婆说的，人多三人以上的或者人少过两人一下的地方一律不能去！”

三斤姐说：“你说话九不搭八的。”
我嘿嘿两声：“你要去就一个人去吧！
去看看也好，让你感受一下现实的浪漫，哦不对，是浪漫的现实。”
三斤姐反应也真是够慢半拍的，她说：“那我自己去啦！”
我对她招招手：“好狗不宠，好走不送。”
看着她几乎是奔奔跳跳的朝情人岛飞奔过去的样子，我就在想，今晚千万不能给她找到我了，否则她会杀了我的。
我在同学中，以爱捉弄女同学出了名的，小学时候因此没少给女同学施以栗凿，可是依然乐哉其中。
在下读书就不见厉害，捉弄女同学的鬼点子挺多。
我一个人赤脚走在沙滩上，赤脚走在沙滩上，放松的感觉从每一个脚趾传递给大脑，可是也是奇怪，同样的，如果两手空空的不拿着什么，尤其手机的话，手部神经传递给大脑的信息却是“我很恐慌，周围不安全”
，整个人就觉得莫名的空虚，甚至不知所措。
我从兜里掏出手机，这部水果手机也用了有好几年了，和最新的相比，落后了许多，耳机还是有线的，老婆用过了的，然后在某款水果最新款出来之前，就老对我说手机真的很慢，不顺畅，怕耽误炒股和炒期货。
如此的说了好几天之后，我终于投降了，你要买就买啊！
老婆说，我可没说啊，谁说谁买。
我说好好好。
然后就老婆用新的，我用她的，儿子用我的。
儿子因此扁扁嘴，我什么时候才能用全新的手机？老婆恶狠狠的说，你现在读书，给你用还想怎样？儿子看着这神情像白雪公主后母似的老妈，目光转向我，我说，不用看我，都是层层下来的，我也没用过新款的新手机，你更别想！
你就当是退耕还田好了。
我打开微信，在紫萱建的群里发了个呲牙的符号，没人理会。
想了一下，脑袋里的策划推理分析又出来了罗列：
content_en:
Sister Sanjin was very angry: "You are just not serious.
It would be great if you could face difficulties like this with a smile. "
I was a foot away from her: "Old fellow, I got it, I understand, I understand!
To be honest, I don't want to give up such a good opportunity. After all, this opportunity is more real and tangible than any before. "
I changed the topic and said, "Just come out on your own. Where is Xiao Chen?"
She said: "Young people naturally play with young people. She is with Ying Yong, it seems she is over there."
After speaking, she pointed to the small rocky island far to the west.
This small reef island is tens of meters away from the beach. It is actually a sea platform. Looking to the east, you can see the unobstructed semicircular beach of Silver Bay. Looking to the south, you can see the pocket location of Silver Bay and the open sea. Looking to the west, it is more romantic, looking at the stone mountain with the top of the golden sail.
Some seaside hotels have joined forces to turn it into a sea music bar, which is very popular among young people who come to the seaside.
I looked in the direction of her finger and saw a purple tulip floating on the royal blue sea. That was because the island's lights used a large number of purple lights to act as auxiliary lights on the shore of the island.
This small island was originally nothing, just a reef. After it was made into a platform, purple lights were added. The hotel operator also put some soft articles on the Internet to promote it, just like Dali's Erhai Lake, and then gave it a very tacky-sounding name: Lover's Island. But such a tacky name attracted many young people who came to Silver Bay to check in.
Purple is mysterious and romantic, and no one can refuse it.
I was thinking: Isn’t Sister Sanjin going to the island soon? Does she know that the island's name is Lover's Island?
While I was thinking about it, Sister Sanjin said to me excitedly: "Mumufan, let's go to the island for a walk too!
Sit back and listen to music. "
I pretended to be righteous and said: "Sister Sanjin, I have a family.
Don't do this. "
Sister Sanjin's eyes widened angrily: "Are you going or not?!"
I acted unafraid: "I won't go if I don't!
My wife said that you cannot go to any place where there are more than three people or less than two people! "
Sister Sanjin said: "What you say is totally inconsistent."
I said, "If you want to go, just go alone!"
It’s okay to go and see it, let you feel the romantic reality, oh no, it’s the romantic reality. "
Sister Sanjin's reaction was really slow. She said, "Then I'll go by myself!"
I waved to her: "Don't pamper a good dog, don't give it away if it's a good one."
Seeing her almost running towards Love Island, I was thinking, I must not let her find me tonight, otherwise she will kill me.
Among my classmates, I was famous for teasing my female classmates, so when I was in elementary school, I gave them a lot of slaps, but I still enjoyed it.
I'm not very good at studying here. I have a lot of clever ideas to tease my female classmates.
I walk barefoot on the beach alone, and the feeling of relaxation is transmitted from each toe to the brain, but it is also strange. Similarly, if my hands are empty and not holding anything, especially a mobile phone, the message transmitted by the nerves in my hands to the brain is "I am panicked and the surrounding is not safe."
, the whole person felt inexplicably empty, even at a loss.
I took out my mobile phone from my pocket. I have been using this fruit phone for several years. Compared with the latest ones, it lags far behind. The earphones are still wired and my wife has used them before. Before the latest model of a certain fruit phone came out, she always told me that the phone was really slow and not smooth, and she was afraid of delaying stock trading and futures trading.
After saying this for several days, I finally surrendered. If you want to buy it, just buy it!
My wife said, I didn’t say it, whoever said it will buy it.
I said okay, okay.
Then my wife used the new one, I used hers, and my son used mine.
The son's mouth became flat because of this,When can I use a brand new phone? My wife said fiercely, "You are studying now, what do you want if I use it for you?" My son looked at his mother, who looked like Snow White's stepmother, and turned to me. I said, "Don't look at me. It's all layer upon layer. I haven't used a new mobile phone, let alone a new one!"
Just think of it as returning farmland to farmland.
I opened WeChat and sent a toothy symbol to the group created by Zixuan, but no one paid any attention.
After thinking for a while, the planning, reasoning and analysis in my head came out again:
